description: Sanctions screening candidates for Korean and North Korean names: expands a person or company name through Korean romanisation variants (Lee/Yi/Rhee/Ri, Choi/Choe, hyphenation) and matches against official US OFAC, UN, EU and UK lists, refreshed daily. Returns ranked candidates for human review, not a determination. Price: $0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.
name: kr_name_sanctions_screen
